decisions.reason: The firm featured this candle arch on its home page, it sits close to the core craft offer and uses existing workshop skills, so the visible commitment and the fit with the firm's tradition favour keeping it.
This one-tier pyramid is a classic core product shown on the home page, so dropping it would write off a visible investment in the firm's signature line.

The electronic music box is distant from the core offer, but the firm presented it prominently on the home page as a new direction, and weak early results can still be blamed on a slow market start, so management persists.
This motif platform was only mentioned on the website, is an accessory distant from the core offer and carries little public commitment, so little has to be justified in dropping it.
The Christmas motif platform received little visibility, but its seasonal theme ties it to the core offer and supports the music box that is being kept, so it narrowly stays.
This Dresden-themed pyramid builds on the established offer, was featured on the home page and fits the firm's tradition, so its strong commitment favours keeping it.
